validation_note: Probe uses the longest training states, with a different small validation subset. This is an infrastructure check, not policy quality.
calculation_source:
from safetensors.numpy import load_file
import numpy as np
a = load_file("train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft-interrupted/best.safetensors")
b = load_file("train/runs/qwen35-answer-smoke/adapters.safetensors")
assert a.keys() == b.keys()
deltas = [float(np.abs(a[k].astype(np.float32) - b[k].astype(np.float32)).max()) for k in a]
print(len(deltas), sum(v > 0 for v in deltas), max(deltas))
